objective: Enforce project / source / date / review / confidence / source-coverage filters before retrieval (constrain which allowlisted families/sources are queried; reject excluded families) and after retrieval (drop items outside the requested window/tier/confidence and emit source-coverage warnings), preserving source-of-truth discipline.

summary.migrator_change: None — pure filter layer; no new table; schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.persistence: None — the filter is read-only; CLI apply persists nothing to the operator DB.

filter_layer.spec: MetadataFilter(project_key, source_families, date_from, date_to, max_review_tier, min_confidence, require_source_coverage)
filter_layer.pre_retrieval: normalize_filter — fail-closed (MetadataFilterError) on an explicitly requested EXCLUDED family; allowlisted-but-unknown families dropped with requested_family_not_allowlisted; validates date window / tier bound / confidence value; resolves the effective family set + project that constrain the deterministic broker.
filter_layer.post_retrieval: apply_metadata_filter — drops on project_mismatch / family_not_selected / out_of_date_window / review_tier_above_max / confidence_below_min (recorded by reason); date filtering is family-aware (date-incapable families kept with date_filter_not_applicable, never silently dropped); emits no_results_for_family + source_coverage_incomplete; review tier / confidence / source refs / freshness preserved on kept items.
filter_layer.integration: build_hybrid_retrieval gains an optional metadata_filter param (pre constrains families/project; post filters the merged items before apply_context_budget); summary gains filter_applied + filter_summary (dropped_by_reason, effective_families, filter_keys — never the raw query).
